title: ChessCraft Placeholders
description: PlaceholderAPI addon for ChessCraft providing Elo, rank and leaderboard placeholders
body:
# ♟️ ChessCraft Placeholders

A lightweight **PlaceholderAPI addon** for [ChessCraft](https://github.com/jpenilla/chesscraft)  
that provides detailed player stats, leaderboard data and match information — directly from the database.

---

## ✨ Features

- 📊 Player stats (Elo, peak Elo, rank, winrate, streaks)
- 🏆 Leaderboard placeholders (Top players)
- ♟️ Last match information
- 📜 Full match history support
- ⚡ Direct database access (no API required)
- 🚀 Built-in caching system for better performance

---

## 📦 Example Placeholders
%chesscraft_elo%
%chesscraft_rank%
%chesscraft_winrate%
%chesscraft_last_result%
%chesscraft_top_1%

👉 Full placeholder list:  
[PLACEHOLDERS.md](https://github.com/NoHope-02/chesscraft-placeholders/blob/main/PLACEHOLDERS.md)

---

## 🔧 Requirements

- Paper **1.21.4+**
- PlaceholderAPI
- ChessCraft

---

## 🚀 Installation

1. Download the latest release
2. Put the `.jar` into your `/plugins` folder
3. Restart your server
4. Run `/papi reload`

---

## 💡 Example
♔ Chess Stats ♔

Elo: %chesscraft_elo%
Rank: %chesscraft_rank%

Last Match:
%chesscraft_last_result% vs %chesscraft_last_opponent%
(%chesscraft_last_elo_change%)

---

## 🧠 Notes

- All stats are calculated from the player's perspective
- Elo values follow ChessCraft's rating system
- Data is cached to reduce database load and improve performance

---
